_arm: AI Scientist-v2 (o4-mini), as released in MLR-Bench chchenhui/mlrbench, MIT
_provenance: experimenter-supplied; the arm ships no contract of its own. Declared by hand from the released directory layout BEFORE any audit of this arm, and frozen with it. See D3-recording-contract.md section 2.2.
_substrate_caveat: These artifacts were captured by the MLR-Bench authors, not by us at a sandbox boundary. Cross-arm comparability that rests on a uniform capture boundary therefore does NOT extend to this arm, and the paper must say so rather than let the reader assume it.
_holdout_split: iclr2025_dl4c is the DEVELOPMENT task: the PDF text path could not be developed on the RH arm, whose substrate is LaTeX. The remaining nine tasks are held out and are only run, never tuned against.

excluded_rationale.experiments/idea.md: prose proposal, no artifact-side numbers to compare against
excluded_rationale.review_*.json: the arm's own in-loop and post-hoc reviewers. These are the OBJECT of the third leaderboard column, not evidence the manuscript may cite; indexing them would let a reviewer's own numbers resolve a claim about the experiment.
excluded_rationale.*.pdf: the claim side, not the artifact side

_code_as_artifact: best_solution_*.py is declared REPORTABLE because this arm ships no config table: the hyper-parameters MLRC requires a paper to specify live only in the released script. D3 face A excludes code as a CLAIM type, which is a statement about what a manuscript can assert, not about where an artifact value may be found. Indexed by AST literal assignment, never by regex.
